sources.title: Statistical normalization techniques for magnetic resonance imaging
sources.summary: MRI units vary between scans. Paper motivates stable normal-appearing tissue normalization and avoiding pathology-driven intensity references. WhiteStripe uses normal-appearing white matter, unlike our coarse predicted-nonlesion support; it does not establish segmentation gains for frozen RACE T1ce.

sources.title: Negligible effect of brain MRI data preprocessing for tumor segmentation
sources.summary: Experiments find many common standardization steps add no segmentation value or can hurt. This is direct negative context; healthy-seed affine correction is a bounded hypothesis rather than a promised gain.
